turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm finally setting up the ObjTac dataset for my tactile sensor research. Do you have the stats handy? I remember it being pretty big but I want to make sure I allocate enough disk space.
I can help with that. Could you remind me which version or specific dataset split you are referring to? Stats can vary between releases.
It's the standard full set. I recall reading somewhere that it contains 100K samples across 40 objects.
Got it. I'll keep that in mind for your storage planning. By the way, did you get the new mechanical keyboard you ordered last week?

Yes, arrived yesterday. The switches are a bit stiffer than I expected, but the typing feel is great. I'm worried the 100K samples might still be too large for my current SSD if I need to process raw data.
Processing raw tactile data is indeed heavy. You might want to consider external storage or cloud processing if the SSD space is tight.
Yeah, I'll check my remaining space. Thanks for the reminder.
No problem. Let me know if you need help with the data pipeline setup.
Lloyd, quick update on the ObjTac dataset. I dug deeper into the documentation and realized my previous numbers were outdated. It's actually much larger than I thought.
Oh? What are the current figures?
It says it contains 135K samples across 56 objects. That's a significant jump from the 100K/40 objects I used before.
That is a substantial increase. It definitely changes the storage and processing requirements.
Exactly. I need to resize my VM instance before I run the next batch of experiments. Also, is it raining outside? I forgot to close the window.
Let me check the local weather for you... It looks like light rain is starting. You should probably close the window soon.
On it. Back to the dataset, I want to make sure I don't make the same mistake again. I need to update my config file.
Understood. I'll note the new values for your future reference.
